You are interested in exchanging data between [product_name] and the engineering software? Please provide more information about what you want to exchange data with—are you working with a PLC controller or an operator panel? Please specify the devices and the engineering software version you are using.

Hello, I have a project involving an overhead tank equipped with a level transmitter (4 to 20 mA output) and low/high level switches. The pump should start at low level and stop at high level. There is also a two-way valve sequence and a flow meter involved. I need to transfer this process data to engineering software version 14/15 with graphical display on a PC as an HMI, communicating with [product_name] FS4. Could you assist with a program to achieve this process? Regards

Here is a link to a [company_name] website that includes some sample applications: [url]. These resources include examples of communication between [product_name] and an operator panel. They also cover HMI communication starting from [product_name] V11.x (engineering software).

Hello, [product_name] 8 FS:04 is not supported with simulation in the engineering environment (such as operator panel basic simulation). I'm not sure if the same applies to runtime. However, don't worry, you can update the firmware on your [product_name] 8 FS:04. Visit the [product_name] support page at [url]. On the right side, select 'Support,' enter the order number for [product_name], for example: [article_no], and set the filter to 'Product information.' There, you will find relevant details, including a link to update [product_name] 8 FS:04 firmware to FS:06. Hope this provides some assistance.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are working to connect [product_name] 8 FS:04 to engineering software versions 14/15 and visualize their process data on a PC-based operator panel. There is some confusion about compatibility issues and requirements for communication between [product_name] and the engineering software’s visualization environment, especially regarding hardware and firmware versions. Users need reliable data transfer solutions and effective visualization, but run into unclear documentation and challenges due to specific product and software version mismatches.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect smooth data exchange and visualization between [product_name] 8 FS:04 and the engineering software’s operator panel system, with straightforward instructions and example programs to support their setup.
